title: KYE Admissibility Decision
description: Signed admissibility verdict for a proposed action. Carries decision value, reason code, checked dimensions, next-step routing, obligations and reference to the admissibility-evidence record.

action_declared.description: Whether kye.proposed_action.v1.action_declaration is present and the action_type + effect_class are populated. False ⇒ the action is not declared clearly enough to evaluate ⇒ require_clarification (authority cannot resolve an undeclared action).

action_effect_declared.description: Whether the action's effect_class and side_effects are declared (no undeclared side effects).

action_reversible_or_rollbackable.description: Whether the action is reversible/compensatable OR a rollback is available. An irreversible action with no rollback escalates to require_human_review (§36 two_person for safety-critical).

action_safe_in_current_state.description: Whether the declared safe_state_precondition is asserted satisfied by the declarer's safety controller. KYE records this assertion; it does not compute the physical safety envelope itself.

action_risk_classified.description: Whether the proposed action carries an action_risk_classification (the explicit pre-admissibility step). False ⇒ unclassified ⇒ require_clarification. A 'prohibited'/'unacceptable' tier ⇒ reject; a 'high' tier raises the required oversight mode (Dynamic Authority Gate) before admit.
